claims.evidence: No before/after refurbishment photos, receipts, or parts-replacement evidence shown; only a single front-angle outdoor photo.
No ignition test video or photo of flame/hotplate glow; burners and oven function not shown.

risks.risk: Gas burners may not ignite or may have clogged jets
risks.proof: Short video of each burner being lit, showing flame color and stability

risks.risk: Electric hotplate coil may be burnt out or cord damaged
risks.proof: Photo/video of hotplate glowing red when powered, plus close-up of power cord and plug

risks.risk: Oven heating element or thermostat may be faulty
risks.proof: Video of oven interior heating up with thermostat dial turned, showing element glow

risks.risk: Interior oven condition unknown (rust, missing racks, damaged seals)
risks.proof: Clear photos of oven interior with door open, including racks and door seal
risks.if_unproven: priced as poor interior condition, racks missing

risks.risk: Rear/side condition unseen - possible dents, rust, or gas connection damage
risks.proof: Photos of back and both sides, including gas inlet/connector
risks.if_unproven: priced as having unseen cosmetic/structural damage

risks.risk: No brand/model identified, affecting part availability and resale value
risks.proof: Photo of brand/model plate, usually on back or inside oven door frame

risks.risk: Unknown age and usage history despite 'refurbished' claim
risks.proof: Any purchase date, service receipt, or seller statement on age with supporting photo
risks.if_unproven: priced as used/older unit, no warranty assumed

proof_requests: Video of all 3 gas burners and the hotplate being lit/powered on
Video of oven heating element glowing with thermostat set
Photos of oven interior (racks, seals, cleanliness)
Photos of back and side panels, including gas connection point
Close-up of power cord and plug for the electric hotplate
response.reason: The item type (4-burner gas cooker with hotplate) is confirmed by the witness, so it can be priced at worst case given unverified working condition and refurbishment claims, with upside proof requested.
